data.title: Constructing Slope Triangles
data.description: Practice building slope triangles on various lines by selecting appropriate runs and rises to understand rise over run.

challenges.instruction: Build a slope triangle on the line: choose a run, then raise or lower the top corner until it lands back on the line.
challenges.hint: The rise is the slope times the run. Pick a run that makes the rise a whole number of grid steps, then set the top corner.
